review.images: Reviewed the phase-specific Emaar wide hero and nine gallery assets. The nine gallery assets are identical across both releases. The card uses the phase-specific hero and captions identify shared images.
review.location: Verified that both official project pages publish the same map coordinates and brochure. Visually checked all four travel estimates on physical page 4 and disclosed the shared scope.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all 19 physical pages of the Apex Capital-hosted original. Retained 16 residence sheets and checked 20 imperial area panels. For page 18, retained the printed total and disclosed the 10.00 sq ft difference from the component sum. The other panels reconcile within 0.01 sq ft.

unavailable: Separate developer coordinates for the two releases, signed unit areas and a complete developer-hosted plan pack were not verified.
